Customer content and brand setup
One proof cycle and the revision allowance shown at checkout
Launch to FAMtastic-managed hosting
SSL and basic launch verification

Registration of one standard, available new domain for the first year when the customer needs one
Connection of one existing customer-controlled domain as the alternative to new registration
